ANSWER acceptance-gate finding 1 (opened by test): not mine — the finding is correct. The fixture `tests/fixtures/templates/from-stage-combined-resume.yaml` is absent from both the diff and the repository. Without it the runner exits before dispatching anything, leaving both DSFSTG-3 assertions at 0. I cannot create files; the fix must be a code change that adds the fixture.

ANSWER lens-correctness-code finding 2 (opened by review_lenses): wrong — RQLOOP-1 requires that the interrupted iteration and member state are restored correctly, not that every internal guard path is covered. The DSCMBR-1 test sets `stage_statuses.test = "aborted"` deliberately because "aborted" is the status `_cycle_state_write_member_atomic` actually writes for an interrupted member; the test exercises the production data shape. The 'all-complete' pre-scan edge case (Scenario A/B distinction) is an internal correctness guard not named by any ISSUE REQUIREMENT. The gap is future debt, not an unmet requirement under this issue.
